description:
Soon-jung Oh, a modest, ordinary college student in her twenties. Do you think her previous life was the best gisaeng in Joseon?! The spirit of a gisaeng who wakes up when he touches a man makes the man hot, and Soon-Jung Oh, who has lived only innocently, makes love out of nowhere. Soon-Jung Oh, who started a relationship completely different from what he dreamed of, will be able to overcome the original evils of Gisaeng and have the beautiful love he desires?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/home/51705774), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/5tnswjd), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1962072939), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/oh_soonjeong), [MrBlue](https://mrblue.com/webtoon/detail.asp?pid=wt_pure_wz), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=3750594), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H040020120), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H040020120)
